title: OpenClaw Creator: User Asked for a Token Refund for Errors - Business Insider
summary: An AI agent made mistakes while handling sensitive financial documents, causing significant wasted time and frustration for the user. The creator of the AI agent offered a full refund, but the user was already compensated as the service was free.
sentiment_reason: The article focuses on the negative impact of AI mistakes in a sensitive context and the user's frustration, despite the service being free.
